    (i : Nat) (fits : i < Evm.W) :
    Evm.run code { machine with stack := .val ⟨i,fits⟩ :: .slot slot :: tail } =
      if i < machine.store slot then .ok { machine with stack := .val (machine.store.cells (.data slot i)) :: tail } 0 else .revert
